notes: FIXTURE intent (A2, 2026-10-08), generated from assertions.yaml + locators.yaml by build_intents.py; run/mission ids are fixture ids. Written against the D1 proposal SDL (04-schema-proposal.graphql) plus seam types of D3/D6/D7/D9 as of 2026-10-08; the pinned executor schema would reject the new D1 types/properties. Not expressible in biotech-knowledge-intent.v1 and therefore left out: b05-expressed-as-pyridoxine (NUTRIENT_EXPRESSED_AS: object-bearing predicate-only or non-written edge; the intent contract has no proposal kind for an Assertion with an object node but no typed edge); b07-p5p-self-moiety (HAS_ACTIVE_MOIETY: object-bearing predicate-only or non-written edge; the intent contract has no proposal kind for an Assertion with an object node but no typed edge); c06-nutrient-equivalent-326829 (CALCULATED: written by a PROJECTION activity, not an ingestion intent); c07-stoichiometry-326829 (CALCULATED: written by a PROJECTION activity, not an ingestion intent); c08-max-day-326829 (CALCULATED: written by a PROJECTION activity, not an ingestion intent); c09-max-day-309443 (CALCULATED: written by a PROJECTION activity, not an ingestion intent); s01-b6-neuropathy-signal (SAFETY_SIGNAL assessment: no intent proposal kind for kernel Assessments); rpt-b6-threshold-screen with ROW items c10a-c10d (R-85: EXCEEDS_DOSE_THRESHOLD is report-only and is written only inside the published Report; v1 has no Report / ReportItem proposal kind). R-30 (close-out 2026-10-09): DECLARES_COMPONENT verbatim fields moved from edgeProperties to Assertion qualifiers (declaredName:/form:); intent v1 edge.assert.assertion has no qualifiers field, so each affected proposal's rationale starts with 'qualifiers: ...' (gap recorded; assertions.yaml carries the qualifiers).
